note: The one list of content engines both the Lab and the Worker read. An engine is a name bound to a material source and an executor kind the Lab has code for (services/content_engine_registry.py KNOWN_EXECUTOR_KINDS). Add an engine here, then add its formats to content-format-contracts.v1.json and content-engine-registry.v1.json; the Worker reads this list through GET /v1/format-contracts (engines + contentEnginesVersion) and needs no code change. Runbook: docs/ENGINE-REGISTRY-RUNBOOK.md.
